ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels distributed centrally and 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated along the margins and base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions dominate the medial surface of both lobes. Distinct low-intensity black mottling and linear streaks are mapped across these white regions, particularly dense along the trailing edges. High-frequency black spotting is localized at the lower-medial junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the fluke center with an estimated pixel angle of approximately 35-45 degrees; depth is partially obscured by water turbulence at the base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits frequent, irregular serrations. Right lobe displays multiple prominent peaks with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5-15 pixels. Left lobe shows a jagged edge topography with lower amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer lateral edges exhibit a smooth convex curve tapering towards the tips. The trailing edge follows a complex irregular trajectory with localized concavities between serration peaks.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast clusters (white/gray) localized on the distal tips and lateral margins of both lobes, indicating high-density barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High density of unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) predominantly oriented vertically and diagonally across the high-intensity white regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation at the lobe tips; irregular, jagged trailing edge profiles suggesting historical physical wear or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy barnacle colonization creating a distinct, high-contrast textured perimeter at the extreme distal lateral edges.
